title: Great time on bikes
text: Excellent guide and trip.  Saw everything.  Really enjoyed the time and the guide was excellent.
author: T5146TOjohnr

title: Great bike tour through busy Seville
text: Our guide Rigo was excellent - he was calm and knowledgeable. He guided our group of 12 (various nationalities) through the chaos of Seville’s traffic and pedestrians. All the cycling was on cycle lanes but it was busy with people all around. Amazingly there were no dramas, we saw so much, travelling a long way around the city. There was a mix of normal bikes and e-bikes in our group but it wasn’t a problem as Seville is not very hilly so the group could stay together quite easily.
author: leopold25

title: Great guide and a good way to see Seville
text: We had a small group which was great. Our guide Lena was very attentive and informative. I would say we didn’t need electric bikes because Seville is pretty flat, but they added to the fun!
author: scisaacs

title: 10/10 5* Highly Recommend!
text: Excellent bike tour of Seville with superb history lesson. Thoroughly enjoyed and would recommend it to any traveller. Daniel was a great local guide  who made this a highlight of our trip to Seville. 3hrs went far to quickly! 10/10 5*
author: traveldanuk

title: Excellent bike tour
text: Lena was an excellent guide- friendly and informative! Would recommend the tour as covered a great deal of sights!
author: 863elerir

title: Must do experience.
text: A great experience which we highly recommend. Our guide was exceptional sharing a range of knowledge and interesting facts ranging from great eating places to historical sights, markets etc. His knowledge and enthusiasm really made the tour, taking us to a wide range of places across Séville. Our only preference would have been to have a shorter or no coffee break and longer to look at some of the sights. Very easy cycling, a great way to get an overview of Seville and in our opinion a must do activity.
author: T4592PDheleng

title: A good experience
text: A good introduction to the city
author: Flyer50149720961

title: Seville by Bike
text: A brilliant way to see Seville. We took the electric bike tour and sir was an excellent experience. We had Rigo as our guide and his knowledge was extensive, matched by his delivery. 3 hours in total and worth it. Highly recommend you get to see the city this way.
author: David_C

title: Incredible tour, great...
text: Incredible tour, great way to see the highlights of the city. Particularly the keynotes which are suitable for an overview and helps you get your bearings and highlight which places you should return to! Rigo was a great tour guide and very knowledgeable.
author: David_I

title: Absolutely worth it!
text: If you want to get an overview of Seville and feel like some exercise, you should not miss this tour. Our guide Lucas was great and knew a lot of interesting things to report.
author: Valentina P
